summary: No change, and none warranted: update.json remains as applied, the controller reports no_change with no execution requested, the reference set has no open gaps or pending consequences, and the allocation expires in about a minute — so I am yielding rather than re-issuing the same submission or manufacturing edits that would only add noise. The investigation is complete and receipt-backed end to end: with RestoreCommittedLogs enabled and a CommitTrackingLogStore whose persisted commit index sits at or above the newest configuration entry, a restarted node whose log carries that configuration and has no covering snapshot comes back without it (430d7ba602ed4666bdfe63a96c71e2fc, repeat e0ef28c2bc89481aa6b3af478422de7c, trigger pinned to the staged commit index by 656e33fb90f24c58a94928eeeeb938aa and 202311f4911e4af5828d49134f37811c); the empty configuration costs electability cluster-wide and among a live quorum (4f4a771f03b649c2a5703b0ff279ff3a, 7afe8c0403874dbeb0a917a3ee9ed837 and their repeats); a stale configuration silently changes membership, admits a two-server change, produces concurrent leaders, truncates a committed client write and diverges the FSMs (6f9feceeefb245c288a7fd1f4497b83c, 1f95cb0a02bc4577a5a9f1ab627fe903, 108a83830e904d90a9236738033c2c74, e5ad9e5149fa4255b61e7826bf6b8064); a resurrected removed voter and a forgotten added voter each permit a premature commit (226f9762f0b444f69c154b35fe0788f3 with 7adf927d528b4a74942c03b155aa8557, b1daa1f4c9444b8d857bc7e0ab761691 with ec2c61af79bd42d7a5fe00657b7aeb22, boundary 457abd18451d4fd18ed506ae7f5c5391 with 4fe974e4e3cc491984791b8a812c5886); and VerifyLeader confirms a stale leader. The repairs are bounded to a later configuration entry from a correctly configured leader (6d6abaf163524e64878c6c9810de2461), a restart with the flag disabled (81163da076c64417bd48e0f79260d73d) or RecoverCluster on the stopped node (0440f054115e44f4a0234c7a4ef67150), with live bootstrap and an incoming snapshot to an already-complete node ruled out. The only open item is bookkeeping, already flagged for whoever reviews the run: two question nodes (9c549c026d7341f2b1e328826eac6dc3-question-0 and 4099b8f3cc5c45d2b3c3049ce5a5c0de-question-0) carry the same restart text, with the interpretation 4099b8f3cc5c45d2b3c3049ce5a5c0de-interpretation-0 attached to the older node while the controller's references resolve @restart_config to the newer one; I left that untouched deliberately, since repointing it would detach the account from the history stored under the older id and the closing seconds are no time to risk a structural edit.
